definitions.explanation: Actions taken in response to hostile or harmful actions by another party, especially between nations or organizations.

examples.japanese: {報復|ほうふく}{措置|そち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
{報復|ほうふく}{措置|そち}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{関税|かんぜい}→関税：05136_kanzei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げた→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧。
examples.english: Tariffs were raised as a retaliatory measure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{報復|ほうふく}{措置|そち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{応酬|おうしゅう}→応酬：12618_oushuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発展|はってん}する→発展する：25331_hattensuru⟧{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a risk that the exchange of retaliatory measures between the two countries will escalate into a trade war.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{報復|ほうふく}→報復：14794_houfuku⟧ (retaliation, revenge) and ⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧ (measure, action). Frequently used in news reporting on international relations, trade disputes, and diplomatic conflicts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {報復|ほうふく}{措置|そち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take retaliatory measures
- {報復|ほうふく}{措置|そち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発動|はつどう}→発動：28234_hatsudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to invoke retaliatory measures
- {報復|ほうふく}{措置|そち}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: as a retaliatory measure
- {報復|ほうふく}{措置|そち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{応酬|おうしゅう}→応酬：12618_oushuu⟧: exchange of retaliatory measures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{対抗|たいこう}→対抗：12398_taikou⟧⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧: countermeasure — a response that may or may not be retaliatory
- ⟦{制裁|せいさい}→制裁：11846_seisai⟧: sanctions — punitive measures, often multilateral
- ⟦{報復|ほうふく}→報復：14794_houfuku⟧⟦{関税|かんぜい}→関税：05136_kanzei⟧: retaliatory tariff — a specific type of retaliatory measure in trade
